title: FlashRecord
description: One lightning flash, normalized across sources. Written by ingestion, stored by the pipelines.

flash_id.description: Deterministic id: first 128 bits of sha256("source|product_file|native_flash_id"), hex.

product_file.description: Base name of the L2 product file the flash was read from.

native_flash_id.description: Flash id as written in the product file.

event_time.description: Flash start time as measured by the satellite (UTC, microseconds).

ingest_time.description: When ingestion received the product file (UTC, microseconds).

lat.description: Latitude of the flash centroid, degrees north.

lon.description: Longitude of the flash centroid, degrees east.

energy_raw.description: Optical energy as reported by the source, in energy_unit.

intensity.description: Normalized optical intensity derived from energy_raw (mapping defined in #33).

area_km2.description: Area covered by the flash, square kilometres.

quality.description: Quality caveats; empty when the flash is nominal.
